q1d8128b2.question: Item a2: Confirm whether the first release includes lightweight palette/type/component/layout specimens or written guidelines only before designing story s6.
q1d8128b2.choice: Include lightweight palette, typography, component-state and representative layout examples alongside written project guidelines in the first release.
q1d8128b2.rationale: Explicit user selection in chat on 11 October 2026; examples illustrate reusable guidelines, not per-page designs.

body.problem: Users who want a consistent project design language must repeatedly restate their intent, compare disconnected choices and carry decisions between conversations themselves. Adding a mobile platform risks losing established brand choices, while routine page work can reopen settled design questions. There is no coherent user journey for creating, reviewing and deliberately revising reusable project guidelines while keeping ordinary consumption separate from authoring.

summary.prose: Let users create and revise reusable guidelines for selected project UI types in a guided conversation. Agents then apply the approved guidelines across pages without repeating design exploration.

nonGoals.text: Per-page design exercises, production screen mockups or framework generation
nonGoals.rationale: This workflow creates project guidelines, not individual page designs.

nonGoals.text: Reimplement corpus ingestion or project lifecycle
nonGoals.rationale: DI1 and DI2 own those dependencies.

assumptions.text: DI1 corpus and DI2 project lifecycle contracts will be reviewed and approved before dependent workflow implementation.
Lightweight guideline specimens are a proposed aid; exact fidelity remains to be confirmed before its story design.

constraints.text: Create distinct guideline sets for requested Web/Mobile-iOS/Mobile-Android types from a shared project brief; page changes never trigger guideline authoring.
Review and explicit version-specific approval precede activation; revisions preserve current approved sets until replacement approval.
Reuse DI1 corpus evidence and DI2 identity/lifecycle; preserve provenance and avoid silent cross-platform changes.
Daemon owns persistence, clients use IPC, cloud access uses CLI providers, provider calls are sequential and critical reasoning obeys the capability floor.
